description: API rehearsal for Notify: same request shape as production send but does not deliver and does not count toward quota. Use before domain verification or when testing the HTTP contract. For real inbox delivery, use send_email after verifying SPF/DKIM.

from.description: Sender address or Name <email@verified-domain.com>. Production custom from requires a verified domain.

html.description: HTML (or plain text) body. Prefer html; message/text also work.
